description: RbNa₁₁(WN₃)₄ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pbca space group. Rb is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight N atoms. There are a spread of Rb-N bond distances ranging from 3.12-3.42 Å. There are six inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five N atoms. There are a spread of Na-N bond distances ranging from 2.42-2.82 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four N atoms. There are a spread of Na-N bond distances ranging from 2.45-2.92 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five N atoms. There are a spread of Na-N bond distances ranging from 2.45-2.89 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded to four N atoms to form NaN₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four WN₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-N bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.47 Å. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five N atoms. There are a spread of Na-N bond distances ranging from 2.45-2.75 Å. In the sixth Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four N atoms. There are two shorter (2.52 Å) and two longer (2.84 Å) Na-N bond lengths. There are two inequivalent W sites. In the first W site, W is bonded to four N atoms to form WN₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaN₄ tetrahedra and corners with two equivalent WN₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of W-N bond distances ranging from 1.84-1.95 Å. In the second W site, W is bonded to four N atoms to form WN₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaN₄ tetrahedra and corners with two equivalent WN₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of W-N bond distances ranging from 1.83-1.96 Å. There are six inequivalent N sites. In the first N site, N is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to one Rb, five Na, and one W atom. In the second N site, N is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to one Rb, five Na, and one W atom. In the third N site, N is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to one Rb, five Na, and one W atom. In the fourth N site, N is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to one Rb, three Na, and two W atoms. In the fifth N site, N is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na and one W atom. In the sixth N site, N is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na and two W atoms.
